Description: "Add a ref-based guard to prevent the cart sync useEffect from writing stale cart data to a newly-selected table. When a table is selected, we set a flag to skip one sync cycle, preventing items from the previous table from leaking into the new one."
Instruction: "Add a ref guard to prevent cart sync from writing stale data when switching tables. Track the previous selectedTable ID and skip syncing on the first render after a table change."
